i.norm: Verifies that each standard BOM constant matches its own raw bytes exactly.
Verifies that each custom BOM matches its own raw bytes exactly.

Verifies prefix-matching behaviour: a BOM matches any array whose leading bytes are identical to the BOM's bytes, even if the array is longer. TEST_BOM_1 has bytes [1]. An input array [1, 2] starts with 1, so it matches.

Verifies that a BOM does NOT match when its bytes differ from the input. Cases covered: - TEST_BOM_1 ([1]) vs [2] — first byte differs - TEST_BOM_2 ([1,2]) vs [1,1] — second byte differs - TEST_BOM_3 ([1,2,3]) vs [1,2,4] — third byte differs
